neighbours.label: the final word of a formal scientific resource name (a database, data bank or measurement scale such as Gene Expression Omnibus, Protein Data Bank, Mercalli Intensity Scale) and the punctuation right after it, as against references to generic, unnamed sources
fire: Sequences were retrieved from the European Nucleotide Archive.
The structures were taken from the Protein Data Bank (PDB).
Expression data came from the Gene Expression Omnibus repository.
Damage was rated on the Modified Mercalli Intensity Scale (MMI; Table 2).
The species is listed on the IUCN Red List of Threatened Species.
Variants were checked against the Genome Aggregation Database.
The compound was found in the Cambridge Structural Database.
Interactions were downloaded from the STRING database (version 11).
quiet: Sequences were retrieved from an online folder.
The structures were taken from our own lab files.
Expression data came from a colleague in Boston.
Damage was rated by the local fire brigade.
The species is listed in an old field notebook.
Variants were checked against a list we made.
The compound was found in a drawer in the basement.
Interactions were downloaded from a shared drive last year.

predictions: fire 0.4-0.75 on the last token of the resource name; generic 'a website' or 'the files' below 0.1
short: end of a named scientific database or scale
notes: Card: ' (' after 'Pygments', ';' after '(MMI', 'ibus' in Omnibus, ' Bank' in Protein Data Bank, 'DEX' in RADEX, '.' after IUCN Red List.
